headline: Canada Expands Foreign Worker Limits for Select Employers to 15%
summary: The Canadian government modified its Temporary Foreign Worker program, permitting eligible businesses to staff up to 15% of workforce capacity with foreign workers for terms up to two years.
why: Canada's immigration policy adjustments directly alter labor availability for agriculture, retail, and construction sectors.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Expanding worker quotas helps relieve structural labor shortages for approved domestic industries.
